summary: This research study compares different doses of the medicine NNC0487-0111 to see how well they lower blood sugar in adults with type 2 diabetes, a condition where the body has trouble processing sugar. A total of 448 participants took part in the Phase 2 study. Patients received either the study drug as injections or pills, or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the real treatment. The study was sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S and has been Completed.
